stem: Nandini looks at the diagram. Straight lines $p$ and $q$ meet at $M$. One angle at $M$ is marked $55^\circ$, and the adjacent angle on the same straight line is marked $x$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The $55^\circ$ angle and $x$ form a linear pair on the same straight line, so $x = 180^\circ - 55^\circ = 125^\circ$.

teacher.key_rationale: Adjacent angles on a straight line add to 180°, so x = 125°. Copying 55° treats the angles as equal; 35° and 110° leave the linear-pair sum.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source triangle as lines p and q meeting at M with 55° and adjacent x on a straight line.
